name: css-migrator
description: Migrates old Steam CSS selectors to the new random gibberish.

scripts.build: npm run compile && node css-migrator.js https://api.deckthemes.com/beta.json ../custom-css/src/ ../custom-css/
scripts.clean-build: npm run compile && node css-migrator.js https://api.deckthemes.com/beta.json ../custom-css/src/ ../custom-css/ true
